config.design: 192 H676 prompts. Native baseline then complete removal of query-input head4, query-input all9heads, or all4demonstration-answer head4 writes at final attention position layer14. Role spans fixed by tokenizer offsets. Primary cells fixed by H676>=75% task/copy rule; all other cells retained.
config.limitations: Removes final-position attention writes from selected source tokens, not source representations or entire heads. Demonstration-answer and query interventions differ in token counts/norms; compare as source-specific necessity probes, not equal-strength importance scores. Full-vocabulary next-token competence only.
